integrity: Exact seven-vertex tree certificate, two independent finite verification programs, and complete sample-space exhaustion for the static support census; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact online classification is restricted to regular labeled tournaments on three, five, and seven vertices; the full fixed-query support polynomial is for seven vertices. Earlier all-odd-order static VC dimension and maximum-support theorem are credited as prior work. No all-order Littlestone formula or claim of absolute historical priority is made.
title: The first adaptive two-round excess for regular tournament orientations
